tiers.purpose: Fast deterministic Workflow Engine checks without browser, live services, production Redis DB 0, or PostgreSQL public schema.
commands: bun test --timeout 30000 tests/workflow-loader-validation.test.ts tests/act-workflow-executor.test.ts tests/eepc-state-machine-regression.test.ts tests/event-activation-policy.test.ts tests/event-waits-list.test.ts tests/runtime-condition-eval.test.ts
tiers.waiver: Only emergency bypass from docs/release-policy.md may skip; record focused replacement checks.

tiers.purpose: Portable integration gate with isolated Redis/PostgreSQL contracts, disposable namespaces, and Workflow Engine integration suites.
warnings: known CI infrastructure flake with rerun evidence
tiers.waiver: Normal releases must not waive this tier. Hotfix waiver requires owner risk acceptance.

tiers.purpose: Browser and TestBench coverage for workflow editor/operator flows without production services.
blockers: failed browser spec touching changed workflow UI
warnings: browser-only coverage not required for backend-only docs or runtime changes
tiers.waiver: Shikadai may waive for docs-only/backend-only changes; record why browser behavior is unaffected.

tiers.purpose: Validate Workflow Engine behavior against the isolated #753 staging lane before production release claims.
warnings: no live staging deployment exists; attach dry-run and waiver from docs/release-policy.md
tiers.waiver: Allowed only as a time-boxed staging waiver; must not weaken prod-core or enable production connectors.

tiers.purpose: Production server gate for live services, Telegram connector, lifecycle/watchdogs, resource pressure, and deploy readiness.
blockers: Telegram smoke failure for connector release
warnings: known unrelated infra WARN recorded in release notes
tiers.waiver: Only hotfix or emergency bypass may skip; run post-deploy healthcheck immediately.

tiers.purpose: Verify Redis active entities are mirrored to PostgreSQL before storage release/cutover claims.
commands: KONOHA_SERVICE_PROFILE=staging-core REDIS_DB=2 DATABASE_URL="$STAGING_DATABASE_URL" bun run scripts/pg-verify.ts
tiers.waiver: PG_READ/cutover work cannot waive onlyInRedis. Other hotfixes may defer with owner risk acceptance.

tiers.purpose: Severity-aware runtime readiness for selected service profile and monitor environment.
blockers: connector enabled without required service health
warnings: known baseline WARNs recorded in issue
tiers.waiver: Warnings may be acknowledged in release notes; FAIL requires emergency bypass wording.

tiers.purpose: Optional Shino/Hinata branch requested by Shikadai for QA-heavy, release, or regression scope.
blockers: requested specialist branch has not reported pass/fail
unresolved regression in changed workflow path
warnings: not requested for ordinary Developer -> Reviewer fixes
tiers.waiver: Shikadai may waive if the issue is not QA-heavy; record this in review notes.
